title: Variables: give values a name
summary: Store a value under a name, then read or update it as your program runs.

scenes.heading: Give a value a name.
scenes.subheading: Variables help your program remember information.
scenes.narration: A variable gives a value a name so your program can use it again.
Here, points is a name that starts with the value zero.
The next line reads the current value and stores ten back in points.
When we print points, its updated value is ten.

points: A variable associates a name with a value
Use the name to read the current value
Assign again to update what it stores
scenes.narration: Name values to make them easier to reuse and update.
